tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search Sundae UI by keyword, optionally filtered by category and tier. Returns metadata and install commands, never source.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All Sundae categories with descriptions and how many assets each holds.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: List the assets in one category, newest first, optionally only free or only pro.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Full documentation for one asset: description, when to use it, props, variants (tweakable options), keyboard support, accessibility, dependencies, usage example and free/pro status.

tools.name: get_usage_example
tools.description: The usage example and props table for one asset. Available for free and pro assets.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: How to install one asset: target directory, shadcn command, dependencies, styling requirements and whether Pro is needed.

tools.name: get_component_source
tools.description: Returns the source files for an asset, to be written under components/sundae/. Free assets need no auth. Pro assets require an API token for an account with active Sundae Pro; the entitlement is checked on the server for every call.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Assets related to one asset (same category, shared tags or art direction), each marked free or pro.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Whether this MCP connection is authenticated and has Sundae Pro. Never returns personal data beyond that.
